# GUI screenshots

`gui-dark.png` and `gui-light.png` are actual browser captures of the running
local application at 1440 × 860, using the bundled fonts and its system-theme
support. The clean screenshot workspace contains no game, source project or
agent configuration. Images are not mockups and contain no retail artwork,
owner paths or authentication URLs.

To refresh them, start the current app with `DECOMP_HOME` pointing to a new
scratch directory, then capture the home view in Chromium with dark and light
system color schemes. Wait for the local state request and fonts to finish.
The README uses a `picture` element to match GitHub's color scheme.
